16 Nov 2024
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1155 - Demand for settlement
Dear Claims Representative:
Our office represents Randall Duncan in connection with the motor vehicle collision
that occurred on 28 Jun 2023 at a signalized intersection. Our client was proceeding
through the intersection on a green light when your insured's vehicle entered against
the signal and struck the driver's side of our client's car. The force of the impact
spun the vehicle and caused our client's left arm to strike the door frame and steering
assembly.
As a direct result, our client sustained a fracture of the wrist that required
emergency evaluation, immobilization, and a surgical procedure to set the bones. Our
client has been unable to work during recovery, has attended repeated physical therapy
sessions, and continues to experience restricted grip strength and pain in daily
activities. Treating physicians have advised that further rehabilitation may be
needed.
The police report documents the signal status and the position of both vehicles, and
independent witness statements are consistent with our client's account. Liability is
clear, and there is no reasonable basis to dispute that your insured caused this
collision.
We therefore demand payment of $126,000.00 to resolve all bodily injury and property
damage claims arising from this loss. This offer will remain open for thirty days from
the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that
period, we will file suit without further notice.
Expert review: Melanie Munoz, orthopedic surgeon
Sincerely,
Daniel Stein
Dunn & Acosta LLP
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
